channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza as fifth Palestinian dies of wounds
item.description: Nearly 1,600 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a US-brokered 'ceasefire' took effect in October last year.

item.title: Explosions hit Iran’s Qeshm Island as US media report US strikes in Hormuz
item.description: Several explosions heard on Qeshm Island and in Bandar Lengeh as US media report US military strikes in Hormuz.

item.title: Multiple Russian strikes kill at least 26 at Ukraine aid centre
item.description: At least 26 people were killed in Russian strikes on a school being used as a humanitarian aid centre.

item.title: Iran war live: US carries out ‘defensive’ strikes in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US forces target Iranian positions in the Strait of Hormuz in "defensive" strikes following missile threats.

item.title: War, tariffs and China: What the US midterms mean for the Asia-Pacific
item.description: Hit hard by Trump's tariffs and the war on Iran, countries in the Asia-Pacific want 'enormous changes' in US policies.

item.title: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections
item.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

item.title: Fake nuclear warning from hacked app sparks unease but not panic in Ukraine
item.description: Many Ukrainians, who have faced years of Russian attacks, did not take the messages seriously and doubted their veracity.

item.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
item.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
item.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

item.title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
item.description: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.
